rubriker.title: Total Chess: Group stage - Live!
rubriker._rss_content: The group stage of the Total Chess Pilot is underway in Budapest, and only the group winners will advance to the knockout final to compete for the tournament title. The 24 participants are divided into four groups of six, playing a double round-robin in each group. From Wednesday to Sunday, each participant plays two games per day with a Fast Classic time control (45+30). On Thursday, Maxime Vachier-Lagrave faces Wesley So, while Fabiano Caruana (pictured) faces Praggnanandhaa Rameshbabu. | Follow the action live, starting at 15.00 CET (9.00 ET, 19.30 IST) | Photo: Michal Walusza

rubriker.title: Total Chess: Top scorers obtain 4/6 points on first day of group stage
rubriker._rss_content: The group stage of the Total Chess Pilot began in Budapest on Wednesday, with players contesting two games at a 45+30 time control. Six players finished the day with 4 points out of a possible 6: Fabiano Caruana, Alireza Firouzja (pictured), Maxime Vachier-Lagrave, Ian Nepomniachtchi, Jan-Krzysztof Duda and Le Quang Liem. The football-style scoring system made an immediate difference, as Magnus Carlsen and Anish Giri - who drew both their encounters - find themselves trailing players who collected a win and a loss. | Photo: Michal Walusza / Total Chess

rubriker.title: Remembering Mikhail Tal
rubriker._rss_content: Today marks the 90th anniversary of Mikhail Tal's birth. Tal was one of the great figures in chess history, playing particularly exciting chess in his youth and becoming the youngest world champion in history in 1960. Unfortunately, he suffered from health problems throughout his life and died at a relatively young age. | Tal giving a simultaneous exhibition in 1977 (Photo: Miass City Museum Archive)

rubriker.title: Recordando a Mijaíl Tal en el 90 aniversario de su nacimiento
rubriker._rss_content: Hoy se conmemora el 90.º aniversario del nacimiento de Mijaíl Tal. Tal fue una de las grandes figuras de la historia del ajedrez. En su juventud practicó un ajedrez especialmente emocionante y, en 1960, se convirtió en el campeón mundial más joven de la historia hasta entonces. Lamentablemente, sufrió problemas de salud durante toda su vida y falleció a una edad relativamente temprana. | Fotografía: Tal ofrece una exhibición de simultáneas en 1977 (Archivo del Museo Municipal de Miass)

CBM 233: Aronian and Pragg shine
rubriker._rss_content: ChessBase Magazine offers a window to the world of professional chess. Nagesh Havanur takes a look at the recent issue, CBM 233. A total of 2911 games from the Biel and Norway tournaments (18 annotated), 10 opening surveys, 3 opening videos, demo lectures and several exercises for training. Annotators include Lubomir Ftacnik. Aydin Suleymanli and Le Quang Liem, among others. The icing on the cake is Anish Giri's analysis of two decisive games from the Quantbox Chennai Grandmasters Tournament. | Photo: Nils Rohde / ChessBase

rubriker.title: The young king faces his toughest challenge
rubriker._rss_content: Gukesh Dommaraju will defend his world title against Javokhir Sindarov in Geneva after a remarkable rise that made him the youngest undisputed champion in history. Since his 2024 triumph, however, the Indian grandmaster has endured a more difficult period and slipped down the world rankings. The match therefore presents a different challenge: rediscovering his best form while facing a younger rival who arrives with strong recent results and considerable momentum. | Image: FIDE
